note: Bridge: new vespera.bridge.include-patterns (default /**) and vespera.bridge.exclude-patterns (default none) in Spring PathPattern syntax narrow the proxy controller mapping; excluded paths fall through to the rest of Spring MVC (other controllers, static resources, then 404) and cors=rust preflights follow the same patterns; defaults keep the /** catch-all unchanged. The JAR ships META-INF/spring-configuration-metadata.json (spring-boot-configuration-processor plus additional metadata) with descriptions for every vespera.bridge.* property, management.health.vespera.enabled, and value hints for dispatch-mode and cors.
